timing: Editorial cue timings retained from the original animation; English narration is a translation and is not aligned to a recorded voice.
cone_representation: Rearward wavefront envelope; no photon trajectories or moving surface markers.

cues.narration: A supersonic aircraft produces overlapping sound waves that form a shock front and a sonic boom.
cues.visual: An aircraft overtakes expanding sound waves, revealing their common rearward envelope.

cues.narration: Similarly, a muon moving through water can produce electromagnetic waves that reinforce one another in particular directions.
cues.visual: The aircraft becomes a muon and water appears; the rearward wavefront envelope is preserved.

cues.narration: The resulting radiation has a conical structure around the direction of motion.
cues.visual: The same apex and rearward envelope become a three-dimensional surface; the camera turns gently.
A simple cone surface trails the muon at a fixed angle, without moving markers.
